description: Aluminium housing block with a pocket, a slot, a blind hole in the pocket floor and an optional chamfer.

precedence_constraints.rationale: Demo assumption: pocket depth is dimensioned from F1.
Demo assumption: slot depth is dimensioned from F1.
Demo assumption: F4 starts at the pocket floor, so the pocket is milled first.

assumptions: Single setup is assumed for the demonstration.
F5 is optional and no chamfer tool or capability is available; a plan may omit it.
Precedence constraints are specific to this demo component and are not general manufacturing rules.

provenance.notes: Toy specification for software testing; not derived from a real CAD model.
